balls.text: ends with a dot. Good length slower ball around leg. Curran misses the swing across the line. To Gurbaz and Kings finish on 191 for 5
full ball on middle and off stump. Swings across the line and hits it to deep midwicket. He calls early for the second and successfully done. Kings touch 190.
pace off. Good length ball just outside leg. Curran adjusts and tucks it to square leg. Gurbaz gives the ball a chase
muscled, that's all power from Curran. Slot ball around middle and off. Curran clears the front leg and finds the bat's sweet spot while swinging across the line. Over wide long on!
slower ball. Good length delivery and fairly wide. Mistimes a flat-batted shot to long on
fullish ball outside off. He waits for it an extra second, and then manages to absolutely cream a slap in front of square. Four written all over it after beating cover
full ball, very wide, beyond the tram-lines. Slices a drive to deep point
like a tracer bullet as Shahrukh smokes a four. In the slot, around the tram-lines, and he hammers a drive rather beautifully
overpitched ball outside off stump. On the bounce to the keeper with him failing to get bat on ball
low full toss on off and drilled to wide long off for a single
overpitched outside off and he guides a drive to deep point
around the stumps. Full ball outside off and Curran smokes a shot over Shardul's head. But long off manages to run around and stop the four
full ball on middle. Turning to off. Tapped with hard hands to the off side

simple for Rana running square from point. Narine with a bit more air on off. Raza backs away and tries to go inside out. Ends up slicing it high for an easy dismissal. KKR quietly pulling things back at the death
full ball outside off. Moves to the off side and attempts the sweep. But the ball slides past his bat to Gurbaz
full ball around leg and clipped to deep midwicket. Anukul runs in to stop
full ball from around the stumps. Sliding into leg. Clipped to midwicket, acres of space there, allowing them two
good length ball outside off. Cut to deep point

release shot successful from Curran. The pressure was building. Full ball wider outside off and Curran smokes it over long on. Still a fairly successful afternoon for Varun. 1-26 in four overs, the last six sending his economy above six
around the stumps. Full ball around leg with Curran backing away. Hits his pad, impact outside leg
good length ball sliding into middle and leg. Clipped to deep backward square leg
fullish ball on middle and leg. Punched down to long on
full ball outside off stump. Sliding into off and swept to deep backward square leg
good length ball around leg. Turning towards middle. Pulled of the back foot to midwicket
full ball outside leg and sliding down with Curran missing the flick. He falls over so there's a stumping chance, but Gurbaz doesn't collect cleanly
full ball outside off stump. The attempted drive takes an inside edge and rolls away to the leg side
full and wider outside off stump. Inside the tram-lines though.

muscled over extra! Sikandar Raza has been in pristine form and he is showing why he became a rare Zimbabwean to get an IPL team this time. Full ball in the slot outside off. Smacked through the off side
good length ball angling into off and he clips it to midwicket for a single only this time
around the stumps. Fullish ball wider outside off stump. Tapped towards cover
good length ball just outside off. Nudged to the off side for one but the fielder attempts a direct hit. Misses!
good length ball on off. Rocks back and punches towards cover point
full ball outside off and a bit of turn away. Pushed to the off side. Carefully played with a slip fielder lurking
full ball around off stump. And fended gently to the off side

through him - and Dhawan's captaincy curse continues where he is yet to get a fifty after being (C).- Good length ball on leg and skidding straight through. Hits Dhawan's pad en route to the stumps. Dhawan goes for 40 with a strike rate of 137
fullish ball outside off. Turning in more. Cut again, close to his body. To point
good length ball outside off. Slaps a cut to point. Can't get a single
around the stumps. Full outside off stump. Cut to deep point, where Shardul runs around to intercept
good length ball on off. Pulled to deep square leg for a single
picks off from where he left off in international cricket! Length ball angling into his body. Raza keeps a steady head and lets his hands do the rest. Flicks it off his waist and gets it to fine leg

too much experience in Southee and he produces another good ball after being hit for a six. Slower ball just outside off stump. Jitesh loses his shape while trying to slog it over the leg side, but this sliced shot produces a simple catch for Umesh at short third
hashtag thumped. Good length ball outside off. Jitesh stands tall and confidently muscles a shot over long off. Swings through the line and that's all Jitesh had to do.
play and miss. Southee starts off with a slower ball. Rolls his fingers over it. Jitesh with a wild attempt over cover. Misses.
back of a length outside off stump. Punched awkwardly, sending the ball to deep point

Vidarbha batter smacks Vidarbha bowler with Jitesh beautifully picking up the slower ball. Umesh went short around off and Jitesh moved to the off side, adjusted after spotting the lack of pace, and sent a pull towards backward square leg. Played the shot with a low to high direction, helping him get the direction
short ball getting big on Dhawan with the ball aimed towards his helmet. Checks a pull, and manages to play it in front of square
full ball outside off. Jitesh moves to the off side and then thumps a grounded shot to long off
slower ball. Good length outside off. Muscled to cover but he parries it towards Umesh successfully. Saves a single
full ball on middle, and clipped to midwicket for a quick single

glorious hit And the bhangra is out in the stands. Tosses it up, just outside off. Jitesh dances down, meets it beautifully, and offers the full flourish after connecting with the shot. Long on a mere spectator. 97m six
full ball just outside off. He presses forward and fends with soft hands
full ball outside off, from over the stumps. Drives gently down to long off for a walking single. Scratch that - two.
good length ball on his pads, and clipped to the leg side for a single
good length ball on middle and sliding down the leg side
full ball outside off. Drives with all the force he has but manages to find deep cover on the off side
full ball from around the stumps. On off. Guided to the leg side for a single

going, going, not gone! Rajapaksa fifty and out. Fullish ball ball around leg and Rajapaksa took one step down the track before trying to tonk it over long on. The connection is decent but not good enough to clear long on. Rinku gets under it and takes a regulation catch a few metres inside the crease. But he's done his job
full ball outside off stump. Angling across with the batter attempting the drive. Misses

a 30-ball fifty by playing a similar shot. Full ball outside off and he checks the drive to ensure he doesn't over-hit. Just lofts it over cover and calls for two with the infielder chasing. The red-coloured PBKS flags are out and fluttering all over

lands safe at wide long off after he checks the lofted shot off this overpitched ball. The timing was good but because he didn't have a followthrough, that did not race away for the boundary. Southee with the successful chase
yorker length, wider outside off. Checks a drive through to Russell at deep extra
yorker length just outside off. Shikhar comes down and then gets the bat out low too. Just gives direction to the delivery and sends the guide to backward point for four
fullish ball around leg and sliding towards middle. Mistimed cut to short third and they scurry across for a single. Team hundred at the halfway mark
good length ball outside off. Bit of turn away. Batter tries to swipe across the line but the shot is toe-ended to the off side instead
half-tracker just outside off and pulled from behind the stumps to deep midwicket. Varun tried some sort of variation there with the legbreak grip but there was no turn anyway
Rajapaksa lucky. Fullish ball just outside leg stump. Rajapaksa goes for a sweep, but the ball hits his arm and rolls past the keeper
full ball around leg stump. Clipped off his pads to deep backward square leg

Varun around the stumps. Bowls a length ball outside off. Dhawan gets low, bending his knees, stays in the crease too, and the extra second allows him to bring the bat square beautifully to pull along the carpet for four
around the stumps. Good length ball, fourth-stump line. Guided towards point and that's finally over.
overpitched ball just outside off. Checks a drive to cover for a single
yorker length, well almost. Lands around leg. Guided towards cover point. No run

that's a wild one and Dhawan has hammered it over point! Ball slips out of his hand, neck high delivery but not dangerous since it is very wide. Dhawan slashes at it, and slices it well enough for a one-bounce four to point. Free hit
inside edge onto his pads as he tries to mow a leg-side swipe across the line. Full ball around off that he tried to smack through midwicket
around the stumps. Full ball, width offered, Rajapaksa pokes at it with the hands going away from his body. Manages to get the nudge between keeper and short third!
good length ball around off and angling accross. Punched to Dre Russ at deep point

chipped in the air but falls short of Rinku at long on. Rajapaksa came down the ground and checked his flick after getting to the pitch. That's probably what saved him too, because Rinku is a fast runner and a safe pair of hands
full ball on middle and leg. Goes back in his crease and taps it to midwicket for a walking single
Rajapaksa lucky as he comes down the track trying to loft this length ball over his head. Delivery takes an inside edge, goes past the stumps to short fine on this occasion

poor from Varun at short fine leg. Good length ball around leg and he mistimes a sweep, playing more of a paddle. Varun at short fine runs to his right and then dives awkwardly, and the ball goes under his body for four.
fullish ball on middle, and clipped off his pads to deep midwicket. Played gently enough for them to comfortable pinch a second run
around the stumps, landing full around leg. He gets low to sweep. Ball hits his bat's handle.
yorker length attempted. Very nearly it. Bhanuka digs it away towards the off side and they scamper across for one. Time out
short ball ball on middle. He tries to play a late guide past the keeper's left, but ends up hitting it to short third
lazy elegance as the commentators of yore used to call it. Short of length on leg. Rajapaksa raises the front leg and nonchalantly clips this from near his hips to send it over fine leg.
short ball around middle. Goes for a cut over the keeper, but gets no bat. Shardul appeals for caught behind. He seems interested. Given not out. They're not reviewing

thumped down the ground, and it goes for four despite Umesh's acrobatic effort at long off. Good length ball on leg but he comes down the track to convert it into a fuller ball. Then lets the bat do the talking, first beating Rana at mid off and then forcing a big run from Umesh from long on to long off
short ball around middle. Pulls from low to high, getting some elevation but the ball lands well short of Rinku at deep square leg

carves a four through the off side by moving to the leg side early and then cutting dangerously past cover point. Dhawan went back and created the width. Was a good length ball around leg that drifted to off.
good length ball just outside off, and guided it late to short third for a single

around the stumps again. Chakravarthy goes short after spotting the batter changing his position. He moved to the off side to try and pull behind square, but ends up losing his balance and mess up the attempt
over the stumps now. Good length originating around leg and sliding towards off. Punched towards cover
falls just short of Anukul at midwicket Half-tracker around off and Dhawan got too excited after seeing the length. Went deep and pulled, but mistimed it. Was in the air for a bit
coming around the stumps. Good length, fourth-stump line outside off. Guided off the back foot to the leg side

icing on the cake! And the most destructive shot of the over. Narine goes fullish around middle and leg. Rajapaksa dances down the track while staying outside the ball's line. Hammers it over the non-striker, and this has enough muscle to go for six more
good length ball on middle, and angling into leg. Rajapaksa shoulders his arms, ball hits his thigh, they take a single. But umpire says no single because he offered no shot there
breaks the wrists to hit it over extra cover. Fullish ball around off. Rajapaksa moves leg side, opening up access towards cover, and then sends it over the infield for four more
that was all intent from the batter. He chose to get on top of Narine and did that by coming down the track and slicing a lofted shot over mid off.
full ball on middle. Ball just hangs a bit in the air before getting to the batter. Gently fended back
around the stumps from Narine to start off. Full outside off and pushed towards cover

rolls his fingers over this delivery. Good length ball outside off and Dhawan attempts a cut, reaching out a tad bit too. Misses, thinks about whether it should've been a wide or not. Feels that's fine, as it indeed was. End of over
good length ball outside off, and Rajapaksa gently taps a cut towards cover point for a single
good length ball on his pads and comfortably flicked off his pads to deep midwicket for a couple
another cut off this good length ball, but point manages to move across to his left and cuts it off
good length ball outside off and Dhawan gets forward and meets a slap from near his waist height. Gets it between the short gap between point and cover point. Replays show the gap was only 9m wide
oh that's been punished. Length ball, width offered too while angling across. Dhawan pounces onto it in a flash, and slaps a cut in front of square. Over the infield too.
fullish ball outside off. Slaps a cut, but the slower ball makes him fail in his shot-placement. To point
full ball around middle and off. Gently tapped to the off side with soft hands
first runs for the captain. Full ball around off and Dhawan tried the drive but it takes an edge to deep third. Goes along the ground.
short length ball around middle, and he cuts it to point on this occasion. Timing is good, but placement is to the fielder
short of length on middle, and he tucks it from near his body to the off side
full ball on middle and off. Dhawan caresses a drive after prodding forward, and Rana has to run to his left from mid off to intercept. Very nearly beat him

Southee has the last laugh as this good length ball angles down leg and Singh can't help himself but try to flick it fine. This time it gets an edge and Gurbaz moves to his left to gobble it up. Singh's cameo is over, but it has given the Kings a positive start

sounded like nostalgia! Short ball on middle and Prabhsimran comes down slightly, and as the ball gets to him, he pulls in front of square magnificently. Like watching your favourite batter play your favourite shot as a kid. Clean sound off the willow.
fullish ball on off. Rolls his fingers over this ball. Gently pushed back to the bowler
short of length, fourth-stump line. Cut to point, from close to his body.
dancing shoes on! Good length ball outside off but Singh wants to give Southee a charge. Gets forward, then offers a flat-batted thwack, and gets it past mid off this time!
full ball around middle and leg. He's searching for the swing but this slides into leg instead. Singh flicks it well, flicks it fine, and beats Umesh at deep fine leg!

almost played on! Prabhsimran would've had his heart in his mouth there. Tried to drive at a ball without any movement of the feet, away from his body. Inside edge took it past leg stump to short fine
good length ball, fourth-stump line and Singh doesn't have the room to get on top of this kind of delivery. Pushed towards cover point off the back foot
#HereWeGo from Prabhsimran. Umesh errs by bowling full on his toes and the batter smartly whips it off his pads and gets a six beyond deep backward square leg. The crowd's delighted!
that's more firm. Sweet sound off the bat. Good length ball outside off and guided after riding the bounce. To point

streaky runs as this short-ish slower ball on off surprises the batter. Tries to tap it square but the ball takes a bottom edge and goes to Gurbaz awkwardly on the bounce. Misfield, slip gives it a chase
full ball outside off. Bit of swing away and he mistimes a drive to mid off. A gentle roar for that first ball at Mohali since 2019 at the IPL
just over long-on! This game is not over yet. Narine showing what he has got. On a good length on the stumps, and just lofted with the least of efforts
fires a yorker length ball on off, which is driven to long-on
full ball on off, and driven to extra cover's right

ramped to point! Another bouncer from Arsh earns him a wicket. The bounce was a bit too much for Iyer to handle. Arsh banged it in short around off, with Iyer almost leaping a little to get on top of it. But he ended up half-ramping it - and without any control - to point
full ball angling into middle. Whipped to deep backward square
sliced on the bounce to deep point. Full and wide-ish of off, as Iyer opens the bat face to loft

ridiculous! Effortless. Too good. Looked like he never really wanted to hit it that far, yet that shortish ball angling away towards off travelled over deep square leg as Thakur pulled almost with disdain

finds deep midwicket! Could be exactly the wrong time for KKR, given there is rain around. Curran went short again, except that this one was an offcutter, which rose sharply after pitching middle and leg, while also angling across. Russell swat-pulled but only off the higher side of the bat
ramps between point and short third! Not very Russell-like, though. Short delivery, almost cramping him for room while rising on middle. He sways away a bit, and lofts it late

low full toss, and heaved away over wide long-on! Perhaps Curran tried the yorker; anyway, it didn't work. Russell got his front leg out of the way while standing deep in the crease, and flung at that
full ball on off, and flicked to deep midwicket
swats this short and wide ball outside off to deep point
slower ball, and a full length on fifth stump. Swatted without timing to long-on
another yorker, and bowled on fifth stump. Russell slashes and misses
now bowls a good yorker just outside off. Jammed down to long-off

drilled over the bowler's head! Why bowl that full, close-to-the-arc length at this stage, and if it's a free hit? That was full and on the stumps, and Iyer rammed that back with the full face of the bat. This is a no-ball too, and it's a late call
good length ball outside off, and hacked to deep point. Russell slips after completing the single. And it is a no-ball
dropped by short fine running back! Prabhsimran the fielder. Ellis isn't happy, but it didn't look very easy too. It was a slower ball and short on off, and Russell pulled and got a top edge
clubbed over mid-off! Stands deep in the crease at this length delivery, which is ending outside off. Russell opened the bat face, and sliced that back forcefully
good length ball, angling in late into middle and off after pitching on off. Stabbed to point
full and wide of off, and turning away while bouncing nicely. Russell misses his attempted cut
full delivery on middle, and swept to deep square
good length on the stumps, and tapped to point for a hurried run
short on middle and leg, and quicker with good bounce. Poked to short third, as Iyer is sent back
fired wayyyy over long-off! Gets his front leg out of the way, and launches this length ball on off to get six
misfield by point, as Iyer reverse sweeps this good length ball on off. Shahrukh the fielder there
goes for the switch hit, but misses the full ball on leg as they pinch a bye off the keeper's pad
now Iyer drills on the bounce to extra cover. Full and wide of off, and he attacks at it
on the bounce to deep midwicket. Short ball angling into leg, and pulled away again
hammered just over the bowler's raised hands! That was bashed back dangerously. Shortish ball around off, and swatted back
short, and angling into the stumps. Punched back
full ball on his pads, and flicked to long leg
slashes and misses. Short ball, turning away - as it was the wrong 'un again - and ending outside off. Half an appeal for caught behind
the googly ends up on leg, after being pitched short on middle and off. Pulled to fine leg
turns away off a short length, and ends wide-ish of off. Hacked to deep point
full and flatter on off. Flay-batted to cover
dabs this short ball straightening just outside off, and the ball goes past slip

strikes first ball, just like Arshdeep! Rinku goes after the legspinner right away, but finds deep midwicket. Chahar bowls on a length on off, but it is the wrong 'un. It turns away from Rinku's arc, as he looks to slog sweep. Instead, the ball ends up landing right into the fielder's lap
good length wide-ish of off, and pushed to deep point
shortish on off, and clipped to deep backward square. Misfield by Arsh allows a second
very full on middle, and whipped to deep midwicket
length ball outside off, hinting to turn away. Pushed to deep point

slashed straight to point! Raza is relieved after going for some runs in his first two overs. That was there to be hit, but Rana ended up gifting the fielder an easy catch. Short and slightly wide of off, as Rana went hard at that only to end up walking back. So the time-out breaks his momentum
stops in his action last moment, and bowls on a length while angling into leg. Swept to short fine
short of a length on middle and off, and punched to point
pulled wide of long-on! Change of pace again from Dhawan, and in vain. He pitched it on the shorter side, angling it across as it ended outside off. Iyer fetched that from there, and crashed that
a tennis-batted hack to point, as this ball is a slower ball again, and is short on off. Played that very late there
slower ball. Good length, and angling away to end wide of off. Slashed to point
a commanding pull! That travelled very quickly over deep midwicket. On the shorter side of a length around middle, and Dhawan's pace isn't that troubling. Rana swung for six
flung away to deep third! Off the top edge, but that will do. Charges down after making room, as Dhawan bowls on a good length outside off. Rana swung, band eventually got four
fullish length angling down leg, as he tried to sweep but missed. They sneak a bye, as the ball went past the keeper too
switch hit lofted over short third! The fielder ran back all the way, but in vain. Good length on off, and swung away
goes low, roundarm, and wide of the crease. Shortish on off, and punched to long-on
short and wide-ish of off. Slashed to deep point
good length, angling into leg. Whipped off his pads to fine leg
chips this full and flat ball on the stumps just wide of long-on, and they pinch two. Good running
short delivery on middle and off, and pulled to deep backward square
makes room, and skips down. Ellis spots that, and bowls on a good length outside leg. Swiped to fine leg
goes driving, but is beaten! Length delivery angling across, and finishing on sixth stump, as the ball passes his outside edge
slower ball on a good length on off. Pushed to extra cover
good length on middle and leg. Clipped to deep backward square
good length ball on leg, taking his pads towards fine leg as he looked to clip

punched between cover-point and extra cover! The last two balls ruin Raza's over. This was short just outside off, as Iyer pushed late it, with the cover-point fielder diving to his right and missing the ball
flicked for four between short fine and square leg! Too quick, and too full, angling into his pads, as Iyer just clipped it using the pace
short outside off, and swatted to mid-off
goes wide of the crease, and bowls roundarm. Ends up bowling on a length, as it slides down leg. Wide called
very full on off, and flicked to midwicket
shortish just outside off, and pushed to long-on
good length darted into middle, and angled in. Iyer misses his pull, and is hit on his pad
now much fuller on off, and pushed back
a touch fuller than the last ball, and on a good length again on middle and leg. Clipped towards deep midwicket
swiped to long leg! Harpreet from deep square leg runs and dives to his left, but in vain. Good length ball on his legs, and pulled away by Rana
full delivery on off, and defended back

Ellis pings off stump! This time Ellis had good pace on ball, changing up after that slower delivery last ball. Gurbaz, again trying to be adventurous, makes some room, and also skips out of the crease. He hacks at this good length ball on off - rather it was on the shorter side of a length - and missed, as the stumps lit up
starts with a slower ball. Full length on off, and he loses his bottom hand while trying to hoick. The ball ends up at cover off his outside edge, and Iyer is just back with the throw arriving there
good length ball angling into off. Punched to cover-point

flashed just wide of short third! Gurbaz runs out of patience, and jumps out of his crease. The ball ended up being a low, dipping full toss outside off, and the ball takes his outside edge with Gurbaz trying to heave
four dots in a row. This is called first bouncer, as Arsh bangs it in short on middle and leg. Gurbaz ducks, as the good bounce takes it high above him
fuller side of a length on leg, and takes his pad as he tries to flick. Again he tries for a single, before going back
good ball. Sees the batter make room, and fires a yorker on fifth stump, which Gurbaz slashes at but misses
shorter side of a length on off, and dabbed to short third. Gurbaz wanted a single, but was sent back
quite full this time on off, and dragged to mid-on's right. Rishi Dhawan there fumbles, as it could have been tight
charges down the track, but Curran bowls short and beats Gurbaz completely. Perhaps Gurbaz skipped out too early after making room, and Curran bowled short on leg. Gurbaz pulled and missed
fullish ball on middle and off. Flicked to deep square elg
short in length on middle, and pulled to fine leg
opens the bat face to dab this good length ball angling across towards off to point
woah, that looked to effortless! Just high elbows, and the full face of the bat, as it was a length ball in the slot on off. Four over mid-off

spooned to midwicket! Arsh gets two in this over. I think the extra bounce came into play again, and so did his pace. Another short delivery from Arsh, and this one's line was a bit wide of off, much further away from the middle-stump line he cramped Anukul with previous ball. Anukul pulled, but found the fielder, who didn't have to move at all
good bouncer. Pitches it short on middle, as Anukul first shapes to swing it away, but then ducks last moment, since the line seemed to be almost cramping him
quite full and wide of off, and he drills that but straight to the extra-cover fielder
lofted over mid-on! That bounced just before hitting the rope. Yup, it's a four. He is standing deep in his crease, and ready to launch this length ball angling into him towards middle stump
good length on fifth stump, and clipped to midwicket. Gurbaz is sent back by Anukul

Arshdeep strikes first ball! He is celebrating with his arms wide, and with half a sprint down long leg. Good pace and bounce from him though. H pitched it about middle and off, as the ball angled across, and rose rather sharply on off stump. Mandeep pulled, but the extra bounce got him. Straight into deep square leg's hands

flicked to deep midwicket! This is a bit fuller, but enough for Gurbaz to slam that away off his pads, as there is no movement off the pitch or from it either. Square leg was placed closer in, and that was hit well
launched high and wide over long-on! Gurbaz gets into the action. Charges down at this length delivery on the stumps, and sends that 101 metres into the stands
makes some room and skips out, as this short ball on off is swatted to mid-on's right
a bit of mix-up, but they are safe in the end. On a good length on off, and tucked to short third off the outside edge. Gurbaz stood still after starting to run, and they eventually made it back
full length, and on off after hinting to angle in. Flicked towards midwicket
floats one quite full, angling it in towards off. Pushed to mid-off
